gloss_en: "expert in returning" (baki be-shov) — the second of the two expertises required for walking the ways of teshuvah in Likutey Moharan 6: the mastery of descent/withdrawal (Zoharic "ve-nafik," exiting), corresponding to "if I make my bed in Sheol, behold You are there" (Ps. 139:8) and the chirik of the Divine Name Sa"G (63) — never despairing but seeking God even when fallen from one's level
